newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Yuzhuralnickel says some output disrupted.
newsitem.headline: Russian Yuzhuralnickel says some output disrupted.

text.p: Russia's small Yuzhuralnickel nickel and cobalt plant in the Urals said on Friday that disrupted deliveries of coke had periodically interrupted output over a recent unspecified time period.
An official from the plant's dispatcher section who declined to be identified said the plant had not worked at all for one day last week, but output had gone according to schedule this week.
"There hasn't been any coke, but we got deliveries this week," she said.
She declined to say how output had been affected or if future disruptions were likely.

Yuzhuralnickel, in the Urals town of Orsk, is one of a handful of small nickel and cobalt producers in Russia that is not owned by Norilsk Nickel, the group which produces the bulk of those metals in Russia.
Kazakh metals officials have said that Yuzhuralnickel buys 2.0-2.5 million tonnes of nickel ore a year from Kazakhstan.
The plant has experienced repeated disruptions to output over the last few years.
